src.quote: Card Name Scapia Federal Credit Card | Issued by Federal Bank | Joining Fees Nil | Annual Membership Fees Nil
Rewards earned on card transactions will be converted to Scapia coins | on the statement date with the conversion ratio 1 Reward = 1 Scapia | Coin.
You will earn 20% rewards on travel purchases made on the Scapia | App.

earn_rules.note: Coins redeem only for travel booked in the Scapia app (travel-only redemption).

src.quote: Also, currently, on your Scapia Federal Rupay Credit Card, | you will earn 5% rewards on eligible spends of more than 500 Rs.

earn_rules.note: Complimentary RuPay card; 'more than 500 Rs.' modelled as a ₹500 minimum. Coins redeem only for travel booked in the Scapia app (travel-only redemption).

src.quote: Currently, on your Scapia Federal Visa Credit Card, you will earn 10% | rewards on every purchase of Rs. 20 and above.

earn_rules.note: Coins redeem only for travel booked in the Scapia app (travel-only redemption).

src.quote: Rewards will not accrue for money transfers, rent payments, cash | withdrawals, EMI transactions, forex transaction, education and school fees, | gift cards, credit card repayments, crypto/digital asset transactions, fuel, fuel | surcharge, rent and digital wallet loading or top-up transactions, Insurance, | Utility, telecom and cable spends.
